# O(1) yearly global sentinel for the 16th-c. Silver Price Revolution (1535-1665).
# Fires at most once per campaign; short-circuits immediately when Rule #14 is off or already active.
yearly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = { oe_cri2_yearly_silver_sentinel }
}

oe_cri2_yearly_silver_sentinel = {
	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cri2_silver_tide_active }
		current_year >= 1535
		current_year <= 1665
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		NOT = { oe_cri2_rule_is_off = yes }
		OR = {
			current_year >= 1565
			AND = {
				current_year >= 1545
				oe_cri2_silver_mine_extracted = yes
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_cri2_silver_tide_active value = 1 }
		oe_cri2_inject_silver_tide_markets = yes
	}
}
